summary: Iteration 3: PayPal integration tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 tests pass (config, order creation for casper_glass & fleet_case, unknown lookup_key -> 404, txn persistence with provider='paypal' status='initiated', capture-unapproved). Frontend: all 4 PayPal gold buttons render (paypal-buttons-1..4 with 8 PayPal iframes present), no SETUP REQUIRED badge, no PayPal SDK console errors, and Stripe BUY WITH CARD (buy-now-1) still redirects successfully to checkout.stripe.com.

minor.issue: Capturing an un-approved order returns 500 Internal Server Error because httpx r.raise_for_status() propagates as unhandled HTTPStatusError. PayPal actually returns a 422 UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY. Should catch httpx.HTTPStatusError and return a structured 4xx response with PayPal error details instead of a bare 500.

action_items: Optional: wrap httpx call in paypal_capture_order in try/except httpx.HTTPStatusError to translate PayPal 4xx into a proper HTTPException instead of surfacing as 500.
critical_code_review_comments: paypal_capture_order and paypal_create_order both use raise_for_status() without try/except; any PayPal-side 4xx becomes an opaque 500 to the client. Wrap and forward status_code + PayPal error body.

PayPal capture endpoint has no auth check; anyone with an order_id could attempt to capture. Consider verifying the transaction exists in payment_transactions first (matches existing lookup_key/provider).
PayPal client_id is returned by GET /api/paypal/config (expected, public value) — correct behaviour.
No idempotency: repeated POST /api/paypal/orders inserts a new payment_transactions row each time even for same lookup_key. Acceptable but noted.
seed_data_creation: Test paypal orders created in sandbox (side-effect); payment_transactions rows inserted with provider='paypal', status='initiated'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayPal sandbox is fully wired. Only outstanding polish item is graceful error handling on /api/paypal/orders/{id}/capture when the order has not been approved by the buyer (currently returns 500). All other flows (Stripe checkout, admin, chat, quote, bookings) verified in iterations 1 & 2.
rca of the issue: 500 on capture of un-approved order: httpx client calls r.raise_for_status(); PayPal returns HTTP 422 with UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY. The exception is not caught and FastAPI converts it to a generic 500. Mitigation: try/except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e: raise HTTPException(status_code=e.response.status_code, detail=e.response.json()).
